[कुण्-करणे घञ् कर्त्तरि अच् वा [[Tv.]]] 
__1 A corner, an angle (of anything); भयेन कोणे क्वचन स्थितस्य [[

.]] 
__2 An intermediate point of the compass. 
__3 The bow of a lute; a fiddle-stick. 
__4 The sharp edge of a sword or weapon. 
__5 A stick, staff, club. 
__6 A drum-stick; … कोणैर्भेर्यो निजघ्निरे [[

.]] 
__7 N. of the planet Mars. 
__8 N. of the planet Saturn. 
__9 A sort of musical instrument [cf. Gr. gonia]. 
-Comp. 
-आघातः striking of drums, tabors &c., used in the sense of ‘a mingled sound of various [Page0608-1] musical instruments’; कोणाघातेषु गर्जत्प्रलयधनघटान्योन्यसंघट्टचण्डः [[

.]] (It is thus defined by Bharata:-- ढक्काशतसहस्राणि भेरीशतशतानि च । एकदा यत्र हन्यन्ते कोणाघातः स उच्यते ॥). 
-कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug. 
-वादिन् m. an epithet of Śiva. 
-वृत्तम् a vertical circle extending from north-east to south-west or from north-west to south-east. 
-शङ्कुः the sinus of the height of the sun.
ind. From angle to angle, corner-wise, diagonally.
